semantic.justification: Original UNOMemoryStream standalone class now supplies genuine XServiceInfo/XStream/XSeekableInputStream/XOutputStream/XTruncate and ByteReader/ByteWriter, native shared cursor/overwrite/truncate behavior and exact exceptions. Both close methods only reset the cursor (CALC-496/WRITER427), without a corrective disconnected flag. ZipStorage SEEKABLEREAD initializes and rewinds this actual cache; real BinaryXInputStream/BinaryXOutputStream integration is exercised. The primitive vector is lowered to signed typed storage with separate logical length and initial1MiB capacity; indeterminate gap bytes, native noinit/allocation/growth/ABI guarantees remain unverified. Factory registration, parent storage/OWriteStream graph, spill files, complete output serializer/package/model/filter/Worker/UI acceptance remain unfinished. Browser file/autosave/recovery choices are unchanged.
